games.title: Glowline 2
games.description: The sequel to Glowline — more glowing-line arcade play.

games.title: Chess
games.description: The classic game of chess, played offline at your own pace.

games.title: Vox
games.description: A side-scrolling action platformer: play a survivor who got their voice back and fight back, one cartoon tactic at a time.
Slide the numbered tiles together. Two that match combine into one worth double — keep going until you reach 2048.

games.title: Snake
games.description: Steer a snake that grows every time it eats. Do not hit the wall, and do not run into yourself.

games.title: Breakout
games.description: Slide the paddle, bounce the ball back up, and clear every brick on the screen.

games.title: Space Invaders
games.description: Rows of aliens march down toward you. Move side to side and shoot them all before they land.

games.title: Pong
games.description: Paddle against the computer. First to seven points wins.

games.title: Gem Match
games.description: Swap two gems to line up a run of the same color. Levels raise the bar from three in a row to four, and a dead board deals itself again.

games.title: Word Wheel
games.description: Spin the wheel, guess a letter, and solve the hidden phrase before your turns run out.

games.title: Peace-Battle
games.description: Split each round between teaching and working, and watch what the split is worth. Replays a real chain from 1903: two thousand people trained fifty thousand, who reached nine million.

games.title: Peace-Battle 2
games.description: A map of sixteen cities where isolation spreads — a place where somebody needs something and nobody findable can do it. Four people with skills spread against it. Cooperative: cover the map and every place on it is reachable, or six places cut off and it is over.

games.title: Specterrealm
games.description: A spooky realm adventure. In progress — coming soon.
